name: hba1c_fitbit
notes: Example spec. Prospective (incident) design: everyone is indexed 180 days after their first valid wear day (100-45,000 steps), features summarise that baseline, outcomes are counted from 90 days after the index (earlier diagnoses exclude the person; lab outcomes use the first value within 730 days), and half the participants are sealed for one-shot replication of the pre-registered candidates. Set design to window for the earlier outcome-anchored design. Column names follow the All of Us Fitbit tables as documented for earlier CDRs; the extractor checks them against INFORMATION_SCHEMA before running, so edit them if your CDR differs. Covariates are extracted for confounder adjustment only (never screened as biomarkers); the agents decide whether to adjust for each, and one that is the outcome itself is left out automatically.
